title: Registrar entrada
purpose: The security guard registers the entry of a vehicle at the gate, by plate and zone, and instantly sees whether the entry was accepted.

sections.name: Page header
sections.description: H1 'Registrar entrada' with breadcrumb 'Inicio / Registrar entrada' and a muted subtitle 'Ingresa la placa y selecciona la zona'.

sections.name: Error alert
sections.description: At the top of the content, a rounded red alert with an exclamation-circle icon and a close button: 'La zona Zona Motos está llena, no hay cupos disponibles'.

sections.name: Main form card (left, 7 columns)
sections.description: White card titled 'Datos del ingreso'. Large plate input labeled 'Placa' with value 'XYZ98D' and placeholder style monospace uppercase; select labeled 'Zona' showing 'Zona Motos (0 cupos libres)' with other options listed softly; a toggle switch 'Vehículo nuevo' turned ON that reveals three extra fields: select 'Tipo de vehículo' (Moto), text input 'Nombre del propietario' (value 'Laura Gómez Rincón'), select 'Tipo de propietario' (Estudiante). Bottom: a large navy primary button with a log-in icon 'Registrar entrada' and a ghost button 'Cancelar'.

sections.name: Availability side panel (right, 5 columns)
sections.description: White card 'Cupos de la zona seleccionada' with a big red '0' libres, a full red progress bar, a red 'LLENA' pill, and below a compact list of the other zones with their free spaces: Zona A - Carros 18, Zona B - Carros 11, Zona Directivas 1, each with colored dots. A helper hint with a lightbulb icon: 'Sugerencia: dirige al conductor a la Zona A'.

state_to_depict: Error state: entry rejected because the selected zone is full. (Alternate version to generate separately: same page with a green success alert 'Entrada registrada: ABC123 en Zona A - Carros a las 07:42' and an empty form.)
